statement: Context decision retrieval must carry supersession and prefer current decisions
rationale: Task context is the default reasoning surface. Returning an older ADR without its successor, or truncating the newest ADR by ascending ID, can steer an agent to a superseded design. The audit reproduced this with ten governing ADRs: the packet returned the eight lowest IDs and no supersession links. Status alone is not enough because the successor ID is not present.
assumptions: An active successor is more relevant than its superseded predecessor.
Agents read the packet before opening every ADR file.
